messages.subject: Error creating detection history
parts:
I have used the following code for detection history

DetHist1 <- detectionHistory(recordTable    = sppRT,
                  stationCol     = "Station",
                  speciesCol     = "Species",
                  camOp          = "camop",
                  recordDateTimeCol    = "DateTimeOriginal",
                  species        = "Common Leopard",
                  occasionLength = 7,
                  day1           = "station",
                  recordDateTimeFormat = "ymd HMS",
                  timeZone = "Asia/Kathmandu",
                  writecsv = TRUE,
                  includeEffort  = TRUE,
                  outDir = "C:/Users/Hp/Pictures/Camera Roll/createStationFoldersTest"
)

But there's an error warning
Error in if (occasionLength > ncol(camOp)) stop("occasionLength must be smaller than the total number of days in camOp") : 
  argument is of length zero

I tried changing the occasionlength and manipulating day1 in the code but to no avail. Clearly the camop is greater than occasion length but not sure why this problem persists.. I also tried checking one suggestion from previous question by Angie Escamilla but it didn't work too. 

Thank you!

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error creating detection history
parts:
Hi,

Your code contains:
camOp          = "camop",

You are quoting "camop", which makes it a character string of length 1.
Do this instead:

camOp          = camop, 

Note taken, I will improve the error message and check that camOp is a matrix first. 
Thank you,
Jürgen
